notes.title: Life's Good? | Update notes
notes.notes:
[b][h2]Additions[/h2][/b]

[olist]
[*] Added item slots
[*] Added stamina and health bars
[*] Added a new shorter intro video
[*] Added 5 more story papers or, as they are called now, logs.
[*] Added Benny
[*] Added The Corrupt
[*] Added a new achievement
[*] Added a new puzzle in the corridors
[/olist]

[b][h2]Edits[/h2][/b]

[olist]
[*] Updated the temporary ending to fit more with the overall story
[*] Made visual improvements to game graphics
[*] Removed much dialogue
[*] Replaced the level A Favor with a new level named Another Western
[*] Reorganized the inventory to be more like a database than an inventory
[*] Redesigned the level chooser to accommodate for the new way of entering and exiting levels
[*] ID's and object orders that are important to the relevant puzzle are now (where it's possible) randomized to prevent memorization
[*] Made the code not depend on save games to relay live data. This should reduce future problems
[*] Made all intractable objects use the new line trace system
[/olist]

[b][h2]Fixes[/h2][/b]

[olist]
[*] Fixed an issue where the paintings in corridors would display the message even if the circumstances didn't allow it
[*] Fixed an issue that made the player character not able to move when re-entering the level Rock Room
[*] Fixed total chapter complete percentage counter not showing the correct percentage.
[*] Fixed total collectibles collected percentage counter not showing the correct percentage.
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43778082/ad86360203593e9650ff892ed7e86d1f75525058.png[/img]
[h1][b]Life's Good? IS HERE!!![/b][/h1]
This is probably the most significant update I have ever made, and will ever do, since this update contains A LOT of new stuff. And it also changes the whole experience, it's still the same game but much more enjoyable and intractable.
Let's talk about the most important additions to the game with this update!

[h1][b]More reliable![/b][/h1]
A full renovation of the code has been done, making it less prone to problems. A large part of that is point 8 in the edits part of the notes, save games are not made to be relays, so I moved to systems that are able to relay live data more reliably. This should, as I said, reduce future problems. The new systems have also made it easier for me to implement stuff like the item slots, which we will be talking about shortly. See what more knowledge does!


[h1][b]Enhanced the experience[/b][/h1]
In this update I have updated the overall game experience by figuring out how to make the game feel more intractable. Because of my knowledge of Unreal Engine and programming overall, the past versions of the game lacked intractability. Now though, it contains much more intractability with the addition of the item slots, where you can pick up and place various smaller items in the inventory / item slots and bring them with you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43778082/bd3dceb1f4c9e47734d3bf0f0832daf9dbeeb117.png[/img]

A sense of progression has been added to the game with the addition of tokens, a small (not so small in reality) coin that you will have to bring back to Benny to be able to unlock the next level.
Speaking of Benny!

[h1][b]More life![/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43778082/9fbba435fb965ab9fdaefd384158c5225690543e.jpg[/img]
Benny is your personal little helper, he will unlock levels for you, keep track of how many collectibles you found, how many clues and logs you found and just look cute. :) He will be able to do more things in the future, but i will keep that a secret for now.


Not everything is good though, hence the name of the update. And that is largely because of an enemy mob that has been added to the game, its name is The Corrupt. I'm not going to tell you much about it, but I will say that it lives in the corridors and if you don't watch your back, you will not be happy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43778082/0bed572989402458affc65edf5a214516b743f7a.png[/img]

notes.title: More Settings Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43778082/341f6c04ac5c8987dc468918dab454665636bb14.png[/img]
[h1]More Settings!!![/h1]
The More Settings update is finally here!
And it contains many new features and fixes, here are the biggest new features!

[list]
[*] Added advanced graphics settings.
Unreal Engine is a heavy one, not only in size but also for your computers "well-being", so customizable graphics settings not only make life easier for players, since they can have maximum frame rates while still keeping some quality, but it also makes your computer work as little as possible, since you have set in the perfect settings for your computer.

[*] Added SFX settings.
Sound is a crucial part of any experience, but sometimes it can get a little loud for your liking. 
So customizable sound settings play a pretty big role in you as a player liking the experience of playing the game.

[*] Added local achievements.
Achievements have been added to give players more stuff to do and also give them a sense of accomplishment. The achievements are not connected to steam yet, but I can assure you that they will be in the next update.

[*] Added collectibles.
Collectibles are another one of these "more stuff to do things" I have added to the game. There is not much to say about them, since it's your job to find them. So, Good luck!

[*] Redesigned the UI:
The UI has been redesigned from the ground up to look better and flow better, it even comes with a full redesign of the main menu. Before it was just a plain image, it looked good yes, but it could be even cooler if it was a 3D environment.
[/list]

Along with these new features come some fixes and quality of life improvements, here is the complete list.
[list]
[*]Changed the object pick up system from trigger boxes to line trace.
[*]Fixed an issue where the level Just Run would auto complete when being reloaded after the last sub-puzzle.
[*]Fixed an issue where the pause button would randomly stop working.
[*]Disabled the ability to pause during cut scenes to avoid any problems.
[*]Improved frame rates in the server room of Just Run from an average of 33fps to an average of 42fps.
[/list]
